statement: BOOT does NOT fully validate Stage 3 or Stage 4: of 18 traced requirement(s): 0 verified, 0 failed, 5 inconclusive, 10 not executed, 3 source-level only and 0 not covered. 7 are fully runtime-observable, 8 partially, and 3 not verifiable at runtime. 14 need a real NinjaTrader installation and 8 need an actual connected Rithmic simulation account.

requirements.title: Dual-policy sizing architecture
requirements.requirement: PERCENTAGE_OF_RISK is the default policy; FIXED_QUANTITY is enabled only by explicit configuration; automatic fallback between policies is prohibited.
requirements.hostData: RiskPilot.BOT read-only sizing reason-code distribution (IReadOnlyDiagnosticSource.ReadStrategies / sizing diagnostics).
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the reported Stage 3 reason-code distribution and attribute each code to the sizing policy outcome.
requirements.currentLimitation: BOOT can observe the sizing reason codes only when RiskPilot.BOT exposes its read-only diagnostics; the policy-selection logic itself is BOT-internal and is not re-derived here.

requirements.title: Fail-closed sizing on missing inputs
requirements.requirement: Missing, invalid, stale or unverified required inputs fail closed with RequestedQuantity = 0 and an explicit reason code (never a fabricated or defaulted quantity).
requirements.hostData: Stage 3 sizing reason-code distribution including zero-quantity outcomes.
requirements.verificationMethod: Count the Stage 3 outcomes and the zero-quantity outcomes; a zero count is only meaningful once the sizing surface was observed.
requirements.currentLimitation: A zero-quantity outcome is reported only as a raw distribution; BOOT does not re-evaluate the sizing math, so it cannot prove a specific input caused a specific reason.

requirements.title: Quantity rounding / min / cap rules
requirements.requirement: Quantity is rounded DOWN to a multiple of QuantityStep; a result below QuantityMin fails closed rather than inflating; QuantityMax is enforced.
requirements.hostData: Stage 3 sizing reason codes (for example CALCULATED_QUANTITY_BELOW_MINIMUM / CAPPED_AT_QUANTITY_MAX).
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the Stage 3 reason-code distribution and report the lattice-related outcomes.
requirements.currentLimitation: BOOT reports the lattice reason codes as a distribution; it does not independently recompute the quantity lattice.

requirements.title: Stage 3 output is analytical and non-executable
requirements.requirement: Stage 3 produces an analytical SizedTradeProposal only; it never submits, modifies or cancels an order, and Trading=Disabled is preserved.
requirements.hostData: Read-only scan of production source plus the tool's runtime read-only posture.
requirements.verificationMethod: Static safety scan of production source for forbidden order/execution APIs, plus the runtime trading-disabled / read-only posture.
requirements.currentLimitation: The scan proves the absence of forbidden patterns in the scanned source; it is a source-level guarantee, not a proof about RiskPilot.BOT's own source.

requirements.title: Structured InvalidationLevel provenance (OD-1)
requirements.requirement: PERCENTAGE_OF_RISK requires a positive numerical InvalidationLevel; prose parsing and fabricated levels are prohibited; a null level fails closed.
requirements.hostData: None: no public NinjaTrader API exposes RiskPilot.BOT's per-candidate InvalidationLevel provenance.
requirements.verificationMethod: Not observable from the host; the boundary is documented from the RiskPilot.BOT contract.
requirements.currentLimitation: No public host API exposes the invalidation producer; BOOT cannot verify it at runtime and reports it as SOURCE_ONLY.

requirements.title: Monotonic quantity invariant
requirements.requirement: 0 <= ApprovedQuantity <= RequestedQuantity; a veto means ApprovedQuantity = 0; Stage 4 never originates or increases quantity.
requirements.hostData: Stage 4 risk-gate reason-code distribution (approvals and vetoes).
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the Stage 4 risk-gate reason-code distribution and report approvals versus vetoes.
requirements.currentLimitation: BOOT observes the risk-gate outcome distribution, not the internal quantity arithmetic; the invariant itself is BOT-internal.

requirements.title: Fail-closed risk gate on missing inputs
requirements.requirement: A missing/invalid risk policy, account state, instrument specification or portfolio evidence vetoes Stage 4 with ApprovedQuantity = 0 and an explicit reason.
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the Stage 4 veto reason distribution and attribute each code to its cause.
requirements.currentLimitation: BOOT reports the veto reasons it observes; it does not reproduce the gate's decision logic.

requirements.title: Non-bypassable verified account state (D-032)
requirements.requirement: Account-state verification is unconditional; a missing, unverified, stale or causally invalid account snapshot vetoes Stage 4; the state-injection setters are non-public.
requirements.hostData: Account identity metadata (Account.All / Connection) and the Stage 4 veto reason distribution.
requirements.verificationMethod: Verify the target account identity/connection, and read the Stage 4 veto reasons for account-state causes.
requirements.currentLimitation: BOOT proves the account identity and observes account-state vetoes; it cannot read RiskPilot.BOT's in-memory AccountStateSnapshot or prove the setter visibility at runtime (that is a source fact).

requirements.title: Compiled immutable RiskPolicyLimits with verified hash (D-036 / D-073)
requirements.requirement: The active SIM risk policy is a compiled, immutable, versioned profile whose content hash is recomputed and compared at resolution; an integrity failure fails closed.
requirements.hostData: None: the compiled profile and its hash live inside RiskPilot.BOT; no host API exposes them.
requirements.verificationMethod: Not observable from the host; the boundary is documented from the RiskPilot.BOT contract.
requirements.currentLimitation: The compiled policy profile and its SHA-256 are RiskPilot.BOT source facts; BOOT cannot verify them at runtime and reports this as SOURCE_ONLY.

requirements.title: Dynamic portfolio state is not zero-defaulted (OD-2)
requirements.requirement: Unknown dynamic portfolio metrics must never silently default to zero; a missing measurement must be required or represented as unavailable and fail closed.
requirements.hostData: None: portfolio state is RiskPilot.BOT-internal; no public NinjaTrader API exposes it.
requirements.verificationMethod: Not observable from the host; the boundary is documented from the RiskPilot.BOT contract.
requirements.currentLimitation: The zero-default hazard is a RiskPilot.BOT source property; BOOT cannot verify it at runtime and reports this as SOURCE_ONLY.

requirements.title: Decision→proposal→risk linkage preserved
requirements.requirement: The Stage 2 decision id, Stage 3 proposal id and Stage 4 risk-evaluation id are preserved and correlated end to end.
requirements.hostData: The three correlation ids supplied by the read-only diagnostic source.
requirements.verificationMethod: Correlate the decision id, proposal id and risk-evaluation id; PASS only when all three are present and consistent.
requirements.currentLimitation: The correlation is only PASS when the read-only source actually supplies the three ids; without them it stays INCONCLUSIVE.

requirements.title: Exact account identity (D-095 / D-096)
requirements.requirement: The operational account is exactly the permanent single-account identity: the exact account name, provider Rithmic, on the existing bound connection, Simulation mode, USD. (The literal account/connection names live only in the reviewed identity definition and are never repeated here.)
requirements.verificationMethod: Enumerate Account.All, match the exact account name ordinally, and compare provider / connection / mode / denomination (fail-closed on any unobservable or mismatching field).
requirements.currentLimitation: Requires the real Rithmic SIM account to be connected; with no account surface the check is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

requirements.title: Exact connection / provider identity (D-096)
requirements.requirement: The account is bound to exactly the permanent connection identity with provider Rithmic, connected, and it is the account's own bound connection (never the first of several).
requirements.hostData: Connection.Connections / ConnectOptions.Provider / the account's own Connection.
requirements.verificationMethod: Resolve the provider by string comparison on the target account's own connection (never the first of several), and confirm both feed states.
requirements.currentLimitation: Provider identity is resolved by string comparison (no guaranteed Rithmic enum member); the provider build is unobservable and never reported as PASS.

requirements.title: Canonical ES/CME instrument identity (D-078 / D-096)
requirements.requirement: The loaded instrument is the ES root on the CME venue, type Future, currency USD; the venue is confirmed by the D-096 configured route, never inferred from the symbol text.
requirements.hostData: Instrument.All / MasterInstrument.Name / InstrumentType / Currency / Instrument.Exchange / MasterInstrument.Exchanges.
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the loaded instrument discovery surface, match the root exactly, and confirm the configured Globex/Rithmic route (fail-closed on unconfirmed exchange metadata).
requirements.currentLimitation: The venue is a configured-route mapping (Owner-authorized D-096), not an independent exchange-issued listing-venue attestation; the raw symbol is never reported.

requirements.title: Canonical ES economic specification (D-095 §4)
requirements.requirement: The ES product economics are point value 50, tick size 0.25, derived tick value 12.50 and USD.
requirements.hostData: MasterInstrument.PointValue / TickSize / Currency of the loaded ES instrument.
requirements.verificationMethod: Compare the loaded instrument's own economics against the canonical CME ES contract facts (fail-closed on any unobservable or mismatching field).
requirements.currentLimitation: The canonical economics are published CME contract facts used as reference expectations, not an independent exchange attestation; the raw symbol is never reported.

requirements.title: DOM / Level II and Level I market-data surface
requirements.requirement: Stage 3/4 sizing and the order-flow inputs depend on a live Level I/Level II market-data surface with observable integrity and freshness.
requirements.hostData: Instrument.MarketData (Level I) and Instrument.MarketDepth (Level II) update events.
requirements.verificationMethod: Subscribe read-only to the loaded instrument's market data / market depth and derive surface, integrity, freshness and validity evidence.
requirements.currentLimitation: Freshness is always INCONCLUSIVE and only labelled FRESH/STALE; depth is never inferred from a Level I quote.

requirements.title: TradeDelta / OrderFlow inputs
requirements.requirement: The order-flow readiness inputs depend on a live trade stream with an observable sequence and direction source.
requirements.hostData: Level I trade prints plus the best bid/ask carried on the same event.
requirements.verificationMethod: Ingest trade prints, derive the direction from the BBO (never provider-confirmed), and measure sequence continuity and completeness.
requirements.currentLimitation: NT8's public Level I surface exposes no aggressor side, so direction is always derived; sequence continuity stays INCONCLUSIVE without an observed source sequence.

requirements.title: Order / execution / position lifecycle audit
requirements.requirement: The post-trade audit reconciles already-recorded order, execution and position events with correlation, timing and missing/duplicate detection.
requirements.hostData: Account.Orders snapshots plus any ingested order/execution/position events.
requirements.verificationMethod: Read the already-recorded order/execution/position surface and reconcile lifecycles, correlation/timing and missing/duplicate events.
requirements.currentLimitation: The audit only covers events recorded while the tool ran; execution coverage is derived (the host reads only Account.Orders), never assumed.
